recipe.install: case $(uname -m) in x86_64|amd64) a=x64; grep avx2 /proc/cpuinfo >/dev/null 2>&1 || a=x64-baseline;; aarch64|arm64) a=arm64;; *) echo 'no opencode build for this CPU'; exit 1;; esac; f=opencode-linux-$a.tar.gz; set -- $(curl -fsSL https://api.github.com/repos/anomalyco/opencode/releases/latest | python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(sys.stdin); a=[x for x in r["assets"] if x["name"]==sys.argv[1]][0]; print(a["browser_download_url"], a["digest"].split(":")[1])' $f) && d=$(mktemp -d) && curl -fsSL -o "$d/$f" "$1" && echo "$2  $d/$f" | sha256sum -c - && tar xzf "$d/$f" -C "$d" opencode && mkdir -p ~/.local/bin && install -m 755 "$d/opencode" ~/.local/bin/opencode && rm -rf "$d"
recipe.tip: The agent of ✦ AI (Settings > AI). First run: `opencode auth login` to pick a provider and add a key; local models via Ollama are supported. Settings > Updates keeps this copy current.
